company.shortDescription: AI-native investment bank for buying and selling small businesses
company.description:
OffDeal is building an AI-native investment bank for buying and selling small businesses.

We use custom AI agents and big data to screen thousands of SMBs each day, matching buyers with the perfect acquisition target in days instead of months. Unlike legacy M&A advisors, we can search for targets for hundreds of buyers concurrently, 24/7.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,511,775 to $100,000,000, a 22.16x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
